title: The Overthinker
line: You check everything and send almost none of it.

title: Sorry In Advance
line: You say sorry before you've done anything.

title: The Essayist
line: Nobody asked for the paragraph. You sent it anyway.

title: Man of Few Words
line: Four words, maximum. Let them wonder.

title: The 3AM Philosopher
line: Nothing good has ever been typed at 3am.

title: The Ex Files
line: That chapter is closed. You keep rereading it.

title: Unbothered
line: You do not chase. It shows in the numbers.

title: Certified Menace
line: It was a terrible idea and you sent it anyway.

title: Smooth Operator
line: Confident, warm, and it lands. Annoyingly.

title: Strictly Business
line: Even your flirting has an agenda item.

title: Hopeless Romantic
line: You always think this one's going to work out.

title: The Hedge Fund
line: Every ask arrives wrapped in three maybes.

line: capital letters are for people with something to prove

title: Fresh Meat
line: Not enough evidence yet. Keep going.
